purpose: Reviewed dispositions for discovery priorities 40 and 39.
keyRule: Each disposition is State-scoped by exact `(state, normalized)` candidate key.

dispositions.reason: CPT is the Council of Europe's anti-torture monitoring committee explicitly described in the Moldova dossier.
The dossier expands CNDH through its national human-rights recommendation context; bind the Mexican National Human Rights Commission identity only.
FPIC is free, prior and informed consent, a rights standard/process rather than an Actor or bounded Project identity.

The existing first-class Project is the exact 28 February 2026 Minab targeting chain. `Operation Epic Fury` can denote a broader operation, so the broad label is not silently collapsed into that narrower project.

NPM denotes the National Preventive Mechanism function; the dossier does not by this abbreviation alone establish whether it should be a separate institution or a function of the Parliamentary Ombudsman.
FARDC is the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, explicitly actor-scoped in the dossier.
SUHAKAM is the Human Rights Commission of Malaysia, explicitly used as a counter/accountability institution.
SAF resolves to the already materialized Sudanese Armed Forces organization; RSF remains separately attributed.

nonInference: A broad operation label is not equivalent to a narrower exact Project.
Institutional monitoring findings do not become ECL outcomes.
Actor identity does not create proxy/support/command relations.
